purpose: Teach: ディスカウント/映し出さ/敬遠/すみやか/追随/係員/きめる/くらべ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、ディスカウント戦略を慎重に使われた
lines.en: When you were starting out, you used discount strategy very carefully.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Speaks from long memory. Each clause lands with quiet weight. Pauses between thoughts—not for effect, but to honour what he's remembering. Voice stays level and clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品が市場に映し出される様を見据えてらした
lines.en: Yes. He always kept his eye on how the product would appear in the market.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Voice warm but formal—honouring his father's memory through precision. Steady delivery, no rush. The cadence of someone who has thought about this many times.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、難局を敬遠されない方だった
lines.en: He was not someone who shied away from difficulty.
lines.style: Quiet conviction beneath the surface. Speaks slowly, choosing words with care. A slight lift on the final clause—not doubt, but the tenderness of saying something true about someone no longer here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはすみやかな意思決定をされた
lines.en: Yes. He made decisions swiftly when they needed to be made.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Clear, unhurried. A slight warmth on the word 'swiftly'—admiration for his father's decisiveness, not performed but genuine. Grounded, respectful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、他社追随ではなく独自路線で経営された
lines.en: He charted his own course rather than following others.
lines.style: Slower than before. The weight of admiration in every word. Slight pause after 'course'—letting the independence of that choice settle. Voice steady, almost tender with respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは現場の係員にも自ら声をかけられた
lines.en: Yes. He would speak to the staff on the floor himself.
lines.style: Small note of warmth and respect. Not boasting—observing something he clearly valued. Even pace, clear articulation. The quiet pride of a son remembering his father's humility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、人事をきめる時は慎重だった
lines.en: When it came to decisions about people, he was always careful.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Voice slightly softer on 'careful'—not hesitant, but tender. The quality of someone remembering a principle he inherited. Trailing slightly at the end, as if the memory continues beyond words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは他業界とくらべての強みを意識された
lines.en: Yes. He understood what made us strong compared to other industries.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Composed, almost philosophical. A slight rise at the end—not a question, but the opening of a larger understanding. Warm, conclusive, the voice of someone who has learned from what he's remembering.
